inputs.text: A wide, dynamic tracking shot follows a group of mountain bikers as they race across a pristine snow-covered landscape on a brilliant winter morning. The camera moves at speed, keeping pace with the lead biker in a vibrant yellow jacket and orange helmet, who launches into the air over a snow mound, their bike suspended against the clear blue sky. Snow particles explode around them, catching the golden light of the low sun that creates dramatic backlighting and long shadows across the terrain. Several other bikers follow closely behind, their dark silhouettes kicking up plumes of powdery snow as they navigate the undulating mounds. The only sounds are the crunch of tires biting into packed snow, the whoosh of air as they fly through jumps, and the distant sound of heavy breathing and excited shouts. One biker calls out to another with exhilaration: "This is incredible! The light is perfect!" Another responds with a breathless laugh: "Keep pushing! We're almost at the ridge!" The camera glides smoothly alongside the group, occasionally pulling back to reveal the full expanse of the snowy landscape with bare birch trees and dark evergreens lining the edge. The mood is exhilarating, fast-paced, and full of the raw energy of winter mountain biking, with every jump and turn captured in crisp detail against the brilliant white snow and vibrant sky.

A fashion photography work full of surreal romanticism, using a low-angle upward shooting composition, with a clear light blue sky as the background, and the visual focus concentrated on the fantasy blue vegetation and the model walking through it.

The vegetation in the picture is processed into varying shades of blue, from light ice blue to deep cobalt blue. The textures of the leaves and branches are delicate and realistic. The warm brown tree trunks form a sharp contrast with the cool blue leaves, resembling a dreamy forest from another world. An African-American model wearing a yellow and white vertical striped long dress walks slowly on the sand. The warm tones of the dress echo with the surrounding cool blue vegetation. The noon sun casts clear shadows on the sand, enhancing the sense of space and reality in the picture.

The entire scene, with its clean and transparent colors and fantasy settings, not only exudes the vastness of the natural wilderness but also presents a quiet and poetic high-fashion sense due to the surreal vegetation.

six_tuple.name: Pixal3D & TRELLIS.2: Image to Model
six_tuple.capability: Upload a single image. Generate a high-fidelity 3D model with PBR textures using either Pixal3D or TRELLIS.2, toggled by a single switch. Both pipelines share the same DINOv3 encoder and shape/texture VAEs; Pixal3D adds MoGe camera estimation for pixel-aligned geometry. Includes background removal and a complete mesh post-processing pipeline: remesh, decimate, UV unwrap, and texture baking.

metadata.name: 3d_pixal3d_trellis2_image_to_model
metadata.title: Pixal3D & TRELLIS.2: Image to Model

six_tuple.name: Patina: Image to Material
six_tuple.capability: Turn a photo of a surface into a seamless, tiling PBR material with Patina. Built for brick, stone, wood, plaster, fabric and ceramic tile; a mask can restrict the redraw to part of the image.

six_tuple.name: Patina: Text to Material

inputs.text: A wide, dynamic tracking shot follows a group of mountain bikers as they race across a pristine snow-covered landscape on a brilliant winter morning. The camera moves at speed, keeping pace with the lead biker in a vibrant yellow jacket and orange helmet, who launches into the air over a snow mound, their bike suspended against the clear blue sky. Snow particles explode around them, catching the golden light of the low sun that creates dramatic backlighting and long shadows across the terrain. Several other bikers follow closely behind, their dark silhouettes kicking up plumes of powdery snow as they navigate the undulating mounds. The only sounds are the crunch of tires biting into packed snow, the whoosh of air as they fly through jumps, and the distant sound of heavy breathing and excited shouts. One biker calls out to another with exhilaration: "This is incredible! The light is perfect!" Another responds with a breathless laugh: "Keep pushing! We're almost at the ridge!" The camera glides smoothly alongside the group, occasionally pulling back to reveal the full expanse of the snowy landscape with bare birch trees and dark evergreens lining the edge. The mood is exhilarating, fast-paced, and full of the raw energy of winter mountain biking, with every jump and turn captured in crisp detail against the brilliant white snow and vibrant sky.

metadata.name: api_clarity_ai_crystal_video_upscale
metadata.title: Clarity AI: Crystal Video Upscaler
metadata.description: Upscale a video with Clarity AI's Crystal model, running through the Fal proxy: one video in, one upscaled video out. Set scale_factor to multiply the frame size, and the output keeps the source resolution, frame count and audio track. The result is capped at 9 megapixels per frame and 360 megapixel-seconds per clip, so long or oversized clips come back upscaled by less than the factor you asked for. Ideal for restoring generated clips, preparing footage for large screens, and sharpening soft AI video.

Ideal for remixes, style changes, and iterative refinement without re-generating from scratch.

metadata.name: api_patina_material_extract
metadata.title: Patina: Material Extract
metadata.description: Pull a seamless, tiling PBR material out of a photo of a surface with Patina. The prompt says which surface to extract and which structure to keep, and the base texture comes back with basecolor, normal, roughness, metalness and height maps aligned pixel for pixel. Made for photos that already contain the material you want: brick walls, paving, plaster, fabric.

metadata.name: api_patina_material_i2m
metadata.title: Patina: Image to Material
metadata.description: Turn a photo of a surface into a seamless, tiling PBR material with Patina. The source image sets the pattern and Patina redraws it as a tileable material, returning basecolor, normal, roughness, metalness and height maps that line up pixel for pixel. Built for brick, stone, wood, plaster, fabric and ceramic tile; a mask can restrict the redraw to part of the image.

metadata.name: api_patina_material_t2m
metadata.title: Patina: Text to Material

The face in the image speaks the audio, the clip keeps the image's aspect ratio and runs as long as the audio, up to 300 seconds at 480p or 720p. Ideal for avatars, mascots and localized spokesperson clips driven by your own voice recording or a TTS node.

metadata.name: api_veed_lipsync_2_0
metadata.title: VEED Lipsync 2.0: Lip Sync
metadata.description: Re-sync a speaker's mouth in footage you already shot to a new speech track with VEED Lipsync 2.0. The person on camera speaks the new audio while the rest of the shot stays as recorded; the output keeps the video's resolution at 25 fps and runs as long as the audio, up to 600 seconds. If the clip is shorter than the speech it plays forward and backward until the audio ends. Ideal for dubbing a line, swapping a script without re-shooting, or making localized versions of existing footage.

metadata.name: utility_bria_increase_resolution
metadata.title: Image Upscale: Bria Increase Resolution
metadata.description: Upscale any image to higher resolutions using Bria's dedicated resolution enhancement API, which preserves original content without adding new details or regenerating the image. The workflow accepts a single input image and produces one enhanced, higher-resolution output, supporting JPEG and PNG files in RGB, RGBA, or CMYK color modes up to a maximum area of 8192x8192 pixels. Built-in content moderation scans both the input image and generated output to ensure safe, policy-compliant processing. Ideal for preparing images for print, enlarging photos for digital display, or increasing resolution of assets for professional design work.

metadata.name: utility_moge3_geometry_estimation
metadata.title: Geometry Estimation: MoGe 3
metadata.description: Estimate fine-detailed geometry from a single image with MoGe 3, the sparse-volumetric refinement version of MoGe. It lifts a coarse point map onto a sparse voxel shell and refines depth with lightweight sparse 3D convolutions, keeping thin structures and depth discontinuities that image-space decoders blur. Ships with the ViT-L checkpoint; the ViT-G file is selectable in the same Load MoGe Model dropdown for higher fine-detail accuracy. Takes 1 image input and outputs 1 depth map and 1 normal map.

Ideal for fast prompt exploration and concept iteration on H3, with no image input to prepare.
